claim_text: Goodwill impairment assessment involves significant management judgement and is a key audit matter due to the magnitude of goodwill (RMB27,774 million) and sensitivity to assumptions like revenue growth, gross margin, terminal growth, and discount rate.
The gearing ratio as of December 31, 2024, was approximately 32%, calculated as total borrowings and notes payable divided by total equity.
Net cash flows generated from investing activities was RMB10.2 billion in FY2024, primarily from treasury investments.
Net cash flows used in financing activities was RMB30.4 billion in FY2024, driven by share repurchases and debt repayments, partially offset by note issuance.
No material contingent liabilities existed as of December 31, 2024.
The independent auditor issued an unqualified opinion, stating the financial statements give a true and fair view in accordance with IFRS.
The investment portfolio totaled approximately RMB41,309 million as of December 31, 2024, including equity method investments, FVTPL, and FVTOCI instruments.
Credit risk is considered low, with immaterial expected credit losses, as the Group transacts only with reputable financial institutions and has policies for trade receivables.
